content: Atɔŋ, ntɔn an'taaŋ anà ilä, mfun mukàlasɔ̈ɔ̈n yatɛy.
Ntɔn bɛ ŋakwo làkyàyöb ubwaŋàbwaŋ naa ilä a Mwol isàyà asànaa mbüüb uboo a mpib.
Mpal bàsàtɛn baar naa: « Ɔɔ, indiir byanswà abyà u du, byà kà ikyɛɛŋ! », apan, kà imbürà, ibaŋ a mpay isàbwà udu a ba asànaa in'swaŋ udu a un'kaar aŋayöm. Akà mbuur mwɛy usàsɔrà anki.
Wɛɛ bɛ, atɔŋ, bɛ kàlàbà uboo a làpib anki, waa ilä iyàlataan asànaa mbüüb.
Ntɔn bɛ banswà làbà baan a pɛɛlà, baan a mwäänà: bi kibà baar a mpib anki, itàkal bà làpib anki.
Kyakin, wɛy bi ikɔɔn abɔ̈ɔ̈n asànaa baar bumwɛy, wɛɛ bi ikal kigyɛɛŋ anà u làbɔ̈ɔ̈n.
Baar bàfàbɔ̈ɔ̈n, bàfàbɔ̈ɔ̈n u mpib, in'nweel a man, bàfàyɔr u mpib.
Ntɔn bi ibà baan a mwäänà, bi ikal bàlàbɔ̈ɔ̈n, bàŋàbwaar làkwikilà anà ukwen asànaa kàzak ibeenà, anà làkyän a mɔ̈ɔ̈ asànaa mpà ibeenà.
Ntɔn Nzam kisɔ̈ɔ̈l anki naa nkyɛl ande yibweel, wɛɛ muwà mɔ̈ɔ̈ u mbwo a Mwol abi Yɛsu Klistɔ,
awà kàkü ntɔn bi, ntɔn itàkal bàmɔ̈ɔ̈ itàkal bàŋàkwà, bi ibilà mbwo mwɛy anà nde, uboo a mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Kyakin, làlɛɛl bɛ a bɛ anà làpɛɛl ngwal bɛ a bɛ, asànaa làfàtàkyer bɛ.
Atɔŋ, bi kàmàlalɔɔm mukan baar bàfàsal uboo a bɛ, baar, unsà ukwen a Mwol, bàfàlaler anà bàfàlaweey.
Lapɛ làzir anà ukwen, ntɔn isal aba. Làkäl a duu uboo a bɛ.
Atɔŋ, bi kàmàlalɛɛl, làweey aŋunkwɛm, làpɛ ngwal akà baar aŋàyɔn, làbay aŋagyɔ̈ɔ̈là, làkäŋ mpem akà baar banswà.
Làkäl kikyɛɛŋ, wɛy mbuur ukɔɔn afuur ube unsà ube, wɛɛ taaŋ lanswà làkyer ubwaŋ uboo a bɛ anà akà baar banswà.
Làkäl kun'sak taaŋ lanswà.
Làyamà ukɔɔn ayɔn.
Làfuur an'tɔɔn akà Nzam unsà ndaa yanswà, ntɔn ba ukwen ande akà bɛ amu Klistɔ Yɛsu.
Twon lan'düüb mbwo a isal a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl,
twon lan'bɛy ndaa a aŋangɔɔm,
wɛɛ làsyeebà indiir byanswà: làkäär yàŋabwaŋ,
làtön yàmbe yanswà.

Wɛy nde ŋakwo Nzam a duu kàlabuul bàŋukiinà aŋin'kyɛɛl, wɛy dweelà abɛ, mɔ̈ɔ̈ abɛ anà ndür abɛ byàkäl byàŋàtii ubwaŋàbwaŋ, ntɔn bya ikɔ̈ɔ̈n akal anà an'pɛl umpal usàyà Mwol abi Yɛsu Klistɔ.
Nde mbuur kàlabel wà lää, nde mbuur asàkwey ya.
Atɔŋ, làyàmà sye ntɔn bi.
Lapɛ atɔŋ banswà mbɔr u mbwo a ndüür a itɔŋ.
Mɛ amàlabɔɔn kikɔb a Mwol: làtäŋ un'kaan wà akà atɔŋ banswà.
Wɛy kab a ngway a Mwol abi Yɛsu Klistɔ làkäl anà bɛ.
